message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with "TEMPO" in large, dark, serif letters across the top. Below, a large, stylized illustration of a person's face dominates the background. The face is light brown with visible wrinkles and eyes looking forward. Superimposed on the left side of this face is a dark blue silhouette of a person seen from the side, looking down. Within this silhouette is a vertical, cut-out shape revealing a light gray background. Inside this gray area, a smaller, darker silhouette of a figure holding a long, slender object is visible. 

White text on the right side reads "TERORIS DI PELUPUK MATA." Smaller white text below this says: "PENUSUKAN WIRANTO DISIAPKAN SEHARI SEBELUM KEJADIAN. MENGGUNAKAN METODE INGHIMASI— SERANGAN MENDAKAK, CEPAT, DAN MEMATIKAN DENGAN MEMAKAI SENJATA RINGAN." At the top, phrases "KEMATIAN MISTERIUS PENGACARA LINGKUNGAN" and "BARTER POLITIK AMENDEMEN KONSTITUSI" are separated by a diagonal line. A barcode and price information are in the bottom right corner.
